(1) unbalanced thread schedules can improve the performance and energy efficiency of CMPs with SMT cores and (2) scheduling policies that can identify and exploit unbalanced schedules can be implemented in hardware.

(1) unbalanced schedules are more efficient than balanced ones, (2) unbalanced schedules require a larger search space to find the best one, (3) the system can identify and migrate toward a good unbalanced schedule, and (4) the system can do this with a search space that is only slightly larger than the search space for balanced schedules.

(1) unbalanced schedules can be exploited to achieve significant energy savings and/or performance improvements, (2) unbalanced schedules must be identified, and (3) the scheduling policies we have developed can identify unbalanced schedules and migrate the system to a good one, whether balanced or unbalanced.
